question: What professional or pre-professional student orgs are there? I'm an accounting major junior and want something that looks good on a resume
answer:
Professional and career-related options include:
- Beta Alpha Psi — Honor Society - Professional: https://archway.ramapo.edu/BAPsi/ [2]
- Association of Latino Professionals for America — Student Organization; its page describes professional development, networking, career-readiness workshops, internships and mentorship for students pursuing business, accounting, finance and related careers: https://archway.ramapo.edu/ALPFAO/ [3][11]
- Professional Fraternity Council — Greek Life. Its member groups are Alpha Kappa Psi, Alpha Phi Omega and Phi Alpha Delta. Alpha Kappa Psi Professional Business Fraternity is listed at https://archway.ramapo.edu/AKPsi/ [4][5][18]
- Accounting Club — Student Organization. It is open to anyone interested in accounting; members attend networking and leadership events and interact with professionals. Email accountclub@ramapo.edu. https://archway.ramapo.edu/Accounting/ [8][9][10]
- Ramapo Management Consulting Group: offers lectures, networking and free semester-long consulting projects. Email rmcg@ramapo.edu. [14]
- Quantitative Finance Club: lists industry lectures, trading competitions, projects and networking. Email quantitativefinance@ramapo.edu. [12]
- Women in Business — open to all students; offers mentorship, business exposure and career-related support. Email wib@ramapo.edu. [15]

For juniors, the Career Development Center’s four-year plan recommends joining professional associations or organizations. [17] The pages don’t say which organizations will look best on your resume. For resume guidance, contact the Cahill Career Development Center: careercenter@ramapo.edu; (201) 684-7444. [17] For club information, contact the Center for Student Involvement at csi@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7593. [13]

Sources: [2](https://archway.ramapo.edu/BAPsi/) [3](https://archway.ramapo.edu/ALPFAO/) [4](https://archway.ramapo.edu/PFC/) [5](https://archway.ramapo.edu/AKPsi/) [8](https://archway.ramapo.edu/Accounting/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/accounting-club/) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/accounting-club/) [11](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/association-of-latino-professionals-for-america-alpfa/) [12](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/quantitative-finance-club/) [13](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [14](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/ramapo-management-consulting-group/) [15](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/women-in-business/) [17](https://www.ramapo.edu/careercenter/four-year-plan/) [18](https://www.ramapo.edu/greek/chapters-councils/pfc/)

question: Does Ramapo have a Black Student Union or other cultural orgs? how do i join one
answer:
Yes. Ramapo lists the Black Student Union (BSU), category “Student Organization,” with “Lifetime membership”; its page is https://archway.ramapo.edu/BSU/ [1]. Other culturally based organizations listed are Students of Caribbean Ancestry (SOCA), Greek Culture Club, Association of Latinos Moving Ahead (ALMA), Organization of Latino Unity (OLU), South Asian Club, Filipino American Student Association (FASA), Balkan Student Association, United Asian Association (UAA), and African Federation of Representation and Opportunity (AFRO) [2]. Black American Music Club (BAM) also explores music rooted in Black American culture [5]. Culture Club is marked not currently active as of 6/12/25 [6].

The Multicultural Center and Office of Access, Belonging and Community (ABC) lists culturally based organizations and their upcoming programs. Contact ABC at abc@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7720, room D-214 [2].

The Center for Student Involvement says all clubs listed on its page are open to all students [4]. Explore clubs on Archway at https://archway.ramapo.edu or use the Archway app [10]. To get involved with BSU, email bsu@ramapo.edu [3]. ALMA says everyone is welcome; email alma08@ramapo.edu [7]. South Asian Club lists southasians@ramapo.edu [8]. BAM lists bam@ramapo.edu [5]. Center for Student Involvement: csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593, room SC-202 [3].

Sources: [1](https://archway.ramapo.edu/BSU/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/oabc/home/you-belong-at-ramapo/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/black-student-union/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/black-american-music-club-bam/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/culture-club/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/association-latinos-moving-ahead/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/south-asians-ramapo/) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/orientation/faq/)
